help.pageSubtitle: Quick answers to the most common questions.

pricing.title: How does pricing work?
pricing.body:
BebKey offers three plans for sellers and agents:

• Basic - for individual sellers and small landlords. Unlimited active listings, instant publishing, and email match alerts.

• Pro - for real estate agents working with multiple clients. Adds a CRM dashboard, saved searches per client, and priority support.

• Single - one-time payment for a single property. No subscription, no renewals.

Recurring plans start with a free trial period. You can cancel any time from your profile. Refunds are handled per our refund policy.

listProperty.title: How do I list a property?
listProperty.body:
1. Create a free account, or log in if you already have one.
2. Pick a plan that fits - Single if you only have one property, Basic for ongoing listings, or Pro if you're a working agent.
3. From your dashboard, click "Submit listing".
4. Fill in city, price, rooms, and photos. The form auto-suggests neighborhoods and validates the address.
5. Your listing goes live immediately on the search results - there's no review queue.

You can edit, pause, or delete listings any time from the dashboard.

deleteAccount.title: How do I delete my account?
deleteAccount.body:
Go to your Profile → Account → "Delete account".

What happens:
• Your active listings are hidden from search immediately.
• Your data is kept for 30 days in case you change your mind.
• After 30 days, all personal data is permanently removed, in line with GDPR and the Israeli Privacy Protection Law.

If you want a copy of your data first, you can request an export from the same screen, or email support@bebkey.com.

savedListings.title: Where are my saved listings?
savedListings.body:
Tap the ♥ heart icon on any listing card or detail page to save it. Then visit your Saved page from the menu to see all saves in one place.

You need to be logged in for saves to follow you across devices - otherwise they're stored only in your browser and will be lost when you clear cookies.

Your saved listings are private. We don't share them with agents or anyone else.

cookieBanner.title: Cookie preferences
cookieBanner.heading: We use cookies 🍪
cookieBanner.intro: We use essential cookies to keep your session secure. With your consent we also remember your language preference and collect anonymous usage analytics to improve the site. We do not use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.
cookieBanner.detailsIntro: Under the recommendations of the Israeli Privacy Protection Authority (PPA) and the EU GDPR, we ask for your consent before placing non-essential cookies. You can change these preferences at any time from the link in the footer.
cookieBanner.essentialDesc: Required for login sessions and security. These cannot be disabled - without them the site cannot function.
cookieBanner.functionalDesc: Remember your language preference and accessibility adjustments so you don't have to re-select them on every visit. No personal data is sent to third parties.
cookieBanner.analyticsDesc: Anonymous, aggregated usage data (page views, search patterns) via Vercel Analytics. Helps us understand which pages and filters are most useful so we can improve them. No personally identifying information is collected.
cookieBanner.analyticsExample: Vercel visitor ID (no cookies; localStorage only)
